sources.quote: STRESS. Stress in the North Russian dialect of the Gypsy language is expiratory, but the difference between stressed and unstressed syllables is less sharply marked than in Russian. The majority of Gypsy words have stress on the final syllable: adadyves 'today', duratuno 'far'. In oblique case forms [and present-tense verbs it falls on] the penultimate syllable: romestyr 'from the Gypsy', chinava 'I write'.
